card.name: Stumble and stagger word family
card.fires_on: Words built on stumble, stagger or totter, including the opening pieces St-umble and St-agger. It fires on the verb itself, in both literal and figurative uses.

modes.description: Stagger used for spacing out additions or doses, or for an unsteady gait.

modes.label: Totter
modes.description: Tottering used for something about to fall.
